method: paired difference of means over identical observations, with episodes resampled with replacement; CI from the 2.5/97.5 percentiles of the bootstrap difference distribution
why_not_marginal_cis: Overlapping marginal CIs do not imply a non-significant difference for PAIRED data. The paired difference removes the between-episode variance that dominates each marginal CI, so it is the appropriate test here.
